== Title ==
<span lang="ja">気絶に陥るリーダー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">屋内の位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。1フォース消費して、双方の側のすべてのリーダーと能力値＞2のキャラクターを完全にその戦闘から切り離す。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパーは重要な目標を殺さずにスタン（気絶）させる訓練を受けている。これは敵軍を分断し、リーダーを捕まえて尋問するためである。スタンに後遺症はなく、その後の尋問にも支障は出ない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Stunning Leader]].

'''Lore''' — Stormtroopers train to stun, not kill, priority targets, to split the enemy and capture leaders for interrogation. Stun has no aftereffects and does not hinder later interrogation.

'''Game text''' — Play immediately after a battle is declared at an interior location card. Spend 1 Force to cut all leaders and characters with ability greater than 2 on both sides completely out of that battle.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is 気絶に陥るリーダー. Trigger is after battle is declared at an 屋内の位置カード, not after a battle at an interior site is initiated. Exclusion is 切り離す. Lore says stun has no aftereffects; English says stun wears off and requires efficient action.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-stunningleader-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Stunning Leader]].</ref>
